name: Code Block
description: A customizable code block component with syntax highlighting, language badge, and copy-to-clipboard functionality.
thumbnail: Code Block component with syntax highlighting and copy button
usage: Use CodeBlock to display syntax-highlighted source code snippets with theme adaptation and one-click copy support.

props.name: code
props.description: The raw code string to display and copy

props.name: language
props.description: Language for syntax highlighting

props.name: title
props.description: Optional title displayed in the header

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Whether to show line numbers beside code

examples.title: Custom Title and No Line Numbers
examples.code: <CodeBlock code="npm install get-elementa-ui" language={CODE_LANGUAGES.BASH} title="Install" showLineNumbers={false} />

name: Empty State
description: An empty state block displaying theme-dependent illustrations, message headings, descriptions, and action buttons.
thumbnail: Empty State block with illustration and action buttons
usage: Use EmptyState when data collections or views are empty to guide the user towards actionable next steps.

props.name: heading
props.default: 'Woah! That looks like a black hole!'
props.description: Main title message

props.name: text
props.default: 'There is no data available at the moment.'
props.description: Supporting description text

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: primaryButtonOptions
props.description: Configuration for the primary action button

props.name: secondaryButtonOptions
props.description: Configuration for the secondary action button

examples.title: Custom Actions
examples.code: <EmptyState heading="No projects found" text="Get started by creating a new project." primaryButtonOptions={{ text: 'Create Project', onClick: () => {} }} secondaryButtonOptions={{ text: 'Learn More', onClick: () => {} }} />

name: Energy Switcher
description: A dropdown selector block for switching design system energy color palettes dynamically across the application.
thumbnail: Energy Switcher theme palette selector block
usage: Use EnergySwitcher in application navigation bars or settings panels to let users select and preview design energy themes.

name: Error State
description: An error feedback block featuring animated illustrations, custom message headings, text, and action buttons.
thumbnail: Error State block with animation and retry actions
usage: Use ErrorState when operations fail or network errors occur to inform users and provide recovery actions like retry or navigation.

props.name: heading
props.description: Main error title message

props.name: text
props.default: 'An error occurred while loading your data.'
props.description: Supporting error description text

props.name: animData
props.description: Lottie animation JSON data

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

props.name: primaryButtonOptions
props.description: Configuration for the primary action button

props.name: secondaryButtonOptions
props.description: Configuration for the secondary action button

examples.title: Custom Retry Action
examples.code: <ErrorState heading="Failed to fetch data" text="Please check your network connection and try again." primaryButtonOptions={{ text: 'Try Again', onClick: () => window.location.reload() }} />

name: Loading State
description: A loading indicator block with customizable Lottie animation and informative loading text.
thumbnail: Loading State block with animation and label
usage: Use LoadingState while waiting for asynchronous operations or data fetching to complete.

props.name: text
props.description: Loading message to display below animation

props.name: animData
props.description: Lottie animation JSON data

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes

name: Squiggly Text
description: An animated text block that applies a vibrating, wavy squiggly effect using dynamic SVG filters.
usage: Use SquigglyText to create playful, high-energy text callouts or headers with organic animated wobble.

props.name: children
props.description: The text or node to wrap with the squiggly effect

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of distinct displacement frames to cycle through

props.name: stepDuration
props.description: Time between filter swaps in milliseconds

props.name: scale
props.description: Maximum displacement in pixels

props.name: baseFrequency
props.description: Turbulence base frequency for wave smoothness

props.name: numOctaves
props.description: Number of turbulence octaves for detail

props.name: as
props.description: Wrapper element type

name: Theme Switcher
description: A versatile theme toggle block with smooth View Transitions API shape transitions (circle, square, triangle, etc.).
thumbnail: Theme Switcher mode toggle with morphing shape transitions
usage: Use ThemeSwitcher to let users toggle between light, dark, and system themes with smooth animated transitions.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the view transition animation in milliseconds

props.name: fromCenter
props.description: Whether the view transition starts from viewport center or clicked element

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape variant for the transition clip path

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Callback triggered when theme is changed

name: Lightspun Curved Carousel
description: A 3D curved cylinder carousel component powered by GSAP with smooth easing, autoplay, auto-rotation, gesture/drag navigation, and edge fadeout.
thumbnail: Lightspun Curved Carousel 3D cylinder card slider with smooth GSAP animations
usage: Use LightspunCurvedCarousel to showcase cards, media, or portfolio items in an interactive 3D cylindrical carousel.

props.name: slides
props.description: Array of slide items conforming to SlideItem interface

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: T, index: number, isActive: boolean) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Custom render function for each card item

props.name: radius
props.description: Cylinder radius in pixels for natural 3D curve

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective depth in pixels

props.name: slidesInRing
props.description: Total slots in cylinder ring to keep arc seamless

props.name: slideHeight
props.description: Height of individual slides in pixels

props.name: slideWidth
props.description: Explicit slide width override in pixels

props.name: slideSpacing
props.description: Spacing angle gap between slides in degrees

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Enable automatic continuous rotation

props.name: rotationSpeed
props.description: Rotation speed in degrees per frame if autoRotate is true

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause auto rotation when hovering over carousel

props.name: resumeDelay
props.description: Delay in ms to resume rotation after unhovering

props.name: entranceAnimation
props.description: Entrance animation mode for carousel cards

props.name: entranceDistance
props.description: Entrance distance in pixels for fadeUp mode

props.name: fadeOut
props.description: Enable edge fadeout gradient mask

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show bottom manual controls and item detail panel

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for outer container

examples.title: Default Curved Carousel
examples.code: <LightspunCurvedCarousel slides={[{ id: "1", title: "Slide 1", image: "/img1.jpg" }, { id: "2", title: "Slide 2", image: "/img2.jpg" }]} />

name: Glowing Effect
description: An interactive glowing border and background effect that follows pointer movement with customizable spread, blur, and color gradients.
thumbnail: Glowing Effect interactive pointer-following radiant gradient border
usage: Use GlowingEffect inside relatively positioned card or container elements to provide a dynamic mouse-following glowing perimeter.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius in pixels for glow reflection

props.name: inactiveZone
props.description: Inner center threshold ratio where glow becomes inactive

props.name: proximity
props.description: Proximity distance in pixels around element to trigger glow

props.name: spread
props.description: Spread angle in degrees for the glowing cone gradient

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual color theme variant for the glowing gradient

props.name: glow
props.description: Whether the glowing border effect is persistently active

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for outer container

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether pointer interaction and glow animations are disabled

props.name: movementDuration
props.description: Duration in seconds for the glow to rotate toward pointer

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Width in pixels for glowing boundary border
